attribution.note: Zitron directly asserts the description of internal AI projects.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the criticism of observed outcomes without asserting that no efficacy improvement occurred anywhere.

contract.note: Poor functionality and unfavorable cumulative time returns are fair ordinary readings. The representative-project scope and March window are evaluator choices; accounting for repeated use is necessary.

evidence.note: Microsoft reports useful internal tools and substantial savings during the target period, providing limited counterevidence. This company disclosure lacks independent verification, representative sampling and complete development or maintenance costs.

reviews.rationale: The packet contains a relevant positive company account but no representative assessment of the described projects or matched functionality, development, repair and cumulative savings records. It establishes neither the broad criticism nor its opposite.

attribution.note: Zitron directly endorses both the no-replacement assertion and the proposed cause of layoffs.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the asserted causal mechanism and categorical denial of software-engineer replacement.

contract.note: Budget crowd-out and elimination of positions through task substitution are ordinary readings. The assessment window and industry scope require interpretation, while the distinction between tooling costs and broader AI investment is fair.

evidence.note: Atlassian discloses cuts to fund AI and sales investment alongside other objectives. It does not identify unaffordable replacement software, affected engineering tasks or who subsequently performed them.

The report attributes an expected-efficiency rationale to Block. It supplies an alternative stated motive, but no independent verification of actual engineering replacement or evidence isolating the cause of layoffs.

reviews.rationale: Neither employer explanation establishes the claimed tooling-cost mechanism or verifies whether AI performed eliminated engineering work. The packet lacks linked budget, staffing and task-allocation evidence needed to support or contradict the causal assertion.

attribution.note: The completion target is attributed to the developer, but the firm prediction that it will be missed is Zitron's own.

semantics.note: The normalization accurately preserves the definite prediction of incomplete campus construction by October 2026.

contract.note: The original eight-building campus and completion with energization fit the surrounding discussion. October 31 is a fair latest reasonable deadline, and narrower contractor scopes cannot settle campus completion.

evidence.note: Oracle's September disclosure reports six buildings delivered. It establishes interim progress, not the status of all eight at the deadline or an event satisfying the early-resolution rule.

reviews.rationale: The October 31 deadline is after the October 28 evaluation date. Six buildings delivered in September neither proves deadline failure nor establishes full completion. No qualifying early-resolution event appears in the packet.

attribution.note: Zitron directly asserts NVIDIA's advance selling and necessary revenue dependence.

semantics.note: The normalization retains the exclusive dependence assertion and covers both maintaining and growing revenue.

contract.note: Necessary dependence on purchases years ahead of deployment is a fair contextual reading. The latest reported quarter is a reasonable baseline; the packet's causal evidence gap persists regardless of that baseline.

evidence.note: NVIDIA discloses a partnership targeting deployment in early 2027. It does not establish completed purchases years before deployment, recognized revenue or dependence on such purchases.

OpenAI reports workloads running on delivered NVIDIA capacity. This company disclosure provides deployment context but lacks purchase dates and cannot establish NVIDIA's total revenue absent multiyear advance purchases.

reviews.rationale: Future deployment plans and an operating installation do not establish exclusive revenue dependence or refute it. The packet lacks linked purchases, delivery, deployment and recognized revenue, including the revenue NVIDIA could sustain without multiyear advance purchases.
